name: run-after-requested-run-fails
description: the requested run pauses on an interrupt, and a run after it on the same stream fails: RUN_ERROR leaves what was pending, so the thread is still paused on the requested run's interrupt, and the request went as the failed run did. Local to this repository: 1.0 makes the requested run the last of its exchange and says nothing of a consumer that meets one after it; `input.runId` names the run asked for, and `end`, `runs` and `pendingInterrupts` are read on the thread lane only
kill: clear the pending interrupts when a run fails, or report the request as the requested run ended rather than as the run after it did
